sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]On a hill far away stood an [Db]old rugged cross,
[Ab]And I love that old cross where the [Db]dearest and best
Till my [Db]trophies at last I lay [Ab]down;
I will cling to the old rugged [Db]cross,

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Ab]I will cling to [Db]the old rugged cross,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Ab]O that old rugged cross, [Db]so despised by the world,
[Ab]for the dear Lamb of [Db]God left his glory above

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Ab]To that old rugged cross [Db]I will ever be true,
[Ab]then he'll call me some [Db]day to my home far away,
